physics_assertions.claim: The boundary-perturbed mode crosses zero exactly at t1 = 0.8 + gamma/2 = 22/15, where the perturbed first bond decouples (chiral-block determinant zero).
Near t1 = 1.025 the black wiggle dips to min|E| = 0.003 > 0; it never touches zero because the chiral-block determinant has no zero in [0.9, 1.3].
The genuine |E| crossings in t1 [1.0, 1.2] are rendered as crossings via eigenvalue-continuation branches, not as sorted-rank avoided crossings.
The source Fig. 2(d) connects |E| samples by per-t1 sorted rank and draws the genuine crossings as bounces; reproducing that convention on our data recreates the source look.
